acceptance: After an SG-000014 schema revision, core.json.schema_sha256 equals the exact authoritative schema SHA-256 and no other semantic fixture content changes.
Generated packages/contracts/src/conformance.ts embeds the exact new schema digest and exact new core fixture digest and remains generator-derived with the do-not-edit header.
The eight existing core cases retain identical names, definitions, and semantic JSON values relative to the pre-change fixture except for the envelope schema_sha256 field.

Node shared conformance, TypeScript compilation, Rust shared-fixture round trips, generator determinism/--check, pnpm check, git diff --check, Diffcipline R2, protected exact-head CI, and post-merge main qualification pass.
No S05-T03 negative/adversarial scenario is added or preempted.

minimality.rationale: Use the existing tracked core fixture source and existing generator derivative. This Grain only closes two omitted change-surface paths required by the already-authorized schema digest change.

requirements: Digest propagation must not change fixture semantics or introduce a new compatibility/adversarial scenario.
Generated conformance.ts must be regenerated, never hand-edited.

outcome: KRP v1 schema revisions authorized by SG-000014 may update the existing shared core fixture schema digest and its generated TypeScript conformance derivative without changing fixture semantics or absorbing S05-T03 corpus ownership.
rationale: SG-000014 authorizes T02 schema version binding, which necessarily changes the authoritative schema SHA-256. The existing core fixture source binds that digest and the generated TypeScript fixture derivative embeds both schema and fixture digests, but those two paths were omitted from SG-000014 change_surface. This corrective Grain closes that exact authorization gap before implementation.

risk.recovery: Revert the schema-digest binding in core.json, regenerate the TypeScript conformance derivative from the prior authoritative bytes, and revert this corrective closeout. No production wire or persisted runtime data is involved.

scope_in: Authorize protocol/fixtures/v1/core.json to change only its schema_sha256 binding when the SG-000014-authorized KRP v1 schema bytes change.
Authorize packages/contracts/src/conformance.ts to be regenerated from the unchanged semantic core fixture cases so its embedded schema SHA-256 and fixture SHA-256 match the new authoritative bytes.
Require the eight existing core fixture case names, definitions, and semantic values to remain unchanged by this corrective work.
Require generator --check, shared Node conformance, TypeScript compile-time fixture assertions, and Rust shared-fixture round trips to remain green after digest propagation.
Preserve S05-T03 ownership of new adversarial/negative fixture cases; this corrective Grain adds no new protocol scenario.
scope_out: Do not change the authoritative KRP schema, generator logic, compatibility policy, Rust generated contracts, or canonical docs under this corrective Grain; SG-000014 owns those changes.
Do not add, delete, rename, or semantically alter any existing core fixture case.
Do not create the S05-T03 adversarial corpus or compatibility matrix.
title: KX-P01-S05-T02 corrective — Authorize schema-digest propagation to shared fixture derivatives
